EmailTemplate.subject: Reactivating Your Accounts
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Valued Customer,
Greetings form ila. We trust that you are doing great.
We are addressing this email to you to update you that we are required to update your information as part of your account activation.
Kindly reply to this email with your confirmation to activate the account. We have also attached the Customer Update Form (KYC) that we need you to kindly fill out and submit back to us.
Our Support team will be happy to serve you 7 days a week, 24 hours a day on +973 17123456, or you can send us an email to support@ilabank.com
Have a great day!
